## Testing

- [ ] `npm.cmd run check`
- [ ] `npm.cmd run qa:preview-export` when image processing, preview, export, or browser workflows changed
- [ ] `npm.cmd run capture:demo` or `npm.cmd run capture:preset-gallery` when public screenshots or preset docs changed
- [ ] `npm.cmd run build:github-pages` when static deployment paths changed

## Local-first checklist

- [ ] Source images stay local to the browser session
- [ ] Public demo images use repo-safe fixtures or clearly licensed assets
- [ ] Generated files, caches, screenshots, model blobs, and temporary exports are not committed
- [ ] D-drive storage rules are preserved for local scripts and artifacts
- [ ] PolyForm Noncommercial source-available posture is preserved
- [ ] Commercial-use wording still points to TWO HANDS NETWORK LTD and glyn@twohandsnetwork.co.uk
